clue.text: Like the sort of wire that's deliberately hurtful?

definitions.meaning: describes wire fitted with sharp spikes, as on a fence
a cutting remark meant to wound is said to be pointed or spiky

explanation.surface: A question about what kind of wire is intentionally painful.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses of one adjective: spiked, as fencing wire is, and pointedly wounding, as a remark can be.

clue.text: Way a goddess changes direction, ultimately

indicators.note: the last letter, a compass point, is swapped for another compass point

parts.note: Venus is the Roman goddess of love

explanation.surface: A goddess turns to face a new way at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: The final S (south) of VENUS becomes E (east).
explanation.definitionFit: An avenue is a broad street, so a way in the sense of a road.

clue.text: Ejected footballer recovered quickly and easily

parts.note: a nightclub doorman bounces someone by throwing them out
a back is a defending player in football

explanation.surface: A player sent off makes a speedy recovery.
explanation.walkthrough: A BOUNCER is a British doorman who throws out troublemakers.
explanation.definitionFit: To bounce back is the idiom for recovering swiftly from a setback.

clue.text: Ring accepted by daughter determined to give service

indicators.note: the daughter takes the ring after her, so it follows her letter

parts.note: the inner is the ring next to the bull on an archery or darts target
set means fixed or resolved

explanation.surface: A daughter takes a ring, resolved to serve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'service' looks like duty, but it means a matching set of crockery.
explanation.definitionFit: A service in this sense is a full set of matching plates and dishes for a meal.

clue.text: Dismissive remark to Newmarket spy brings series of penalties perhaps

parts.note: shoo is said to send someone or something away
a tout spies on racehorses in training to sell tips; Newmarket is England's horseracing headquarters

explanation.surface: Someone shoos away a racing spy at Newmarket, ending in a run of penalties.
explanation.walkthrough: A racing tout watches horses on the gallops at Newmarket, the Suffolk town famous for racehorse training, to pick up betting information.
explanation.definitionFit: A football or hockey tiebreak decided by a run of penalty kicks or shots is called by this name.

clue.text: Subdues new spouse's child

definitions.meaning: to step on is to crush or suppress
a son from a husband's or wife's earlier relationship

explanation.surface: A stepparent tries to rein in a new partner's child.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as two words, the answer is a phrasal verb meaning crushes.
explanation.definitionFit: A stepson is a son of one's husband or wife by a previous partner.

clue.text: Old graduate touring a hot place in Nebraska

parts.note: an MA is a Master of Arts graduate

indicators.note: going round turns the following pair back to front

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: An elderly graduate goes on tour to a hot spot in Nebraska.
explanation.walkthrough: 'touring' reverses A and H to give HA.
explanation.definitionFit: Omaha is the largest city in the US state of Nebraska.

clue.text: Take moment to listen to twitcher's problem

indicators.note: the word for moment is heard, not spelt

parts.note: a tick is a very short time, as in 'just a tick'

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher pauses to hear what is wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'twitcher' is British slang for a keen birdwatcher, which misleads: here it is someone who twitches.
explanation.definitionFit: A tic is an involuntary muscle spasm, the trouble of someone who twitches.

clue.text: Rise and fall excessively, mostly at end of shore

indicators.note: the word for excessively loses its last letter

parts.note: unduly means to an unwarranted degree

indicators.note: the final letter of shore is taken

explanation.surface: Waves surge too much at the edge of the beach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops Y from UNDULY to leave UNDUL.
explanation.definitionFit: To undulate is to move in a wavelike motion, going up and down.

clue.text: Hymn the succession

definitions.meaning: in church music this is a hymn sung after the gradual at Mass
an order in which things follow one another

explanation.surface: A hymn is linked with the idea of succession, as if to a throne.
explanation.definitionFit: A liturgical chant sung before the Gospel bears this name, and the word also means an ordered series.

clue.text: Covered passageway taking a rebel across river

indicators.note: the a-and-rebel pair lies across the river, so the river letter sits inside them

parts.note: Jack Cade led the 1450 Kentish rebellion against Henry VI

explanation.surface: A covered walkway carries a rebel over a river.
explanation.walkthrough: Jack Cade is the English rebel crosswords most often use for CADE.
explanation.definitionFit: An arcade is a covered walk, often lined with shops, under a row of arches.

clue.text: In Paris, who introduces revolutionary dish?

parts.note: the French word for who is qui
Che Guevara, the Argentine-born Marxist revolutionary

explanation.surface: A French speaker asks who will bring in a radical dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'introduces' is only a link: the French pronoun leads in the revolutionary's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A quiche is a savoury open tart, a specific example of a dish.

clue.text: Platform refreshment room effectively advertised outside

indicators.note: the word for advertised goes round the outside of the refreshment room

parts.note: advertising that works has sold the product
a caff is British slang for a cheap cafe

explanation.surface: A station refreshment room is promoted with posters outside.
explanation.walkthrough: A CAFF is a British informal word for a basic cafe. 'Platform' suggests a railway station, but it means a raised structure.
explanation.definitionFit: A scaffold is a raised framework or platform, such as one used for executions or building work.

clue.text: Initial results following game in trees with birds

parts.note: firs are coniferous trees

indicators.note: the following-and-game pair goes inside the birds

parts.note: tits are small songbirds
F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references
RU is rugby union

explanation.surface: Early results come after a game in woods full of birds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts the following-and-game pair inside the birds; 'Initial results' is a figurative use of a harvest term.
explanation.definitionFit: First fruits are the earliest products of a season, figuratively the first results of an effort.

clue.text: Excavate right away — fireplace appears to crumble

indicators.note: the letter for right is taken away from the word for excavate

parts.note: to disinter is to dig up from the ground
a grate is the metal frame holding fuel in a fireplace

explanation.surface: A digger knocks out a fireplace and it falls to pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'away' removes R from DISINTER, leaving DISINTE.
explanation.definitionFit: To disintegrate is to break up into fragments, which is what crumbling does.

clue.text: Finally in UK, he sold wild hunting dogs

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters run riot into a new order
the last letter of the word in is taken

parts.note: used as its own two letters

explanation.surface: In the end a British breeder sold off untamed hunting dogs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Finally' gives N from 'in'; 'wild' rearranges N, U, K and HESOLD.
explanation.definitionFit: The elkhound is a Norwegian breed of hunting dog used for tracking elk.

clue.text: Saint wickedly beheaded in forceful manner

indicators.note: the first letter of the word for wickedly is cut off

parts.note: wrongly means immorally

explanation.surface: A saint is cruelly beheaded with great force.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beheaded' removes W from WRONGLY to leave RONGLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Strongly means with great force or vigour.

clue.text: Outfit worn by sailor with characteristic restraint

indicators.note: the outfit is put on round the other pieces, so it encloses them

parts.note: a set is a matching group of clothes or equipment
a trait is a distinguishing quality
Jack, as in Jack Tar, is a traditional name for a sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor in uniform shows his typical self-control.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worn by' means the outfit goes round the other pieces. 'Outfit' looks like the definition, but it is the container; the trait comes before the sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: A straitjacket is a garment that binds the arms, and figuratively any severe restraint.

clue.text: It measures current encountered in a European sea

indicators.note: the word for encountered goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: mer is French for sea
met means came across

explanation.surface: An instrument records the flow met in a European sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'current' suggests a flow of water, but it is electric. MER is French, a European language, for sea.
explanation.definitionFit: An ammeter is the instrument that measures electrical current in amperes.

clue.text: Sanctuary unknown in a squalid area

indicators.note: the unknown is placed inside the other pieces

parts.note: a slum is a run-down urban district
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: Refuge is found by a stranger in a rundown district.
explanation.definitionFit: Asylum means protection or refuge, especially that granted to a refugee.

clue.text: Diligent student's grub

definitions.meaning: a person who reads all the time
a larva that bores through books

explanation.surface: A hard-working student is a lowly grub.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an avid reader and the insect larva that feeds on the paper and binding of books.

clue.text: RAF officer upset a number on many occasions

indicators.note: in a down clue the officer's letters are turned upside down

parts.note: FO is a Flying Officer in the Royal Air Force
ten is a number

explanation.surface: An air force officer is upset by a number repeatedly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' reverses FO to give OF.
explanation.definitionFit: Often means frequently, on many occasions.

clue.text: Monstrous female heads off advance

indicators.note: the opening letters are cut from the word for advance

parts.note: progress means to move forward

explanation.surface: A monstrous woman turns back an advance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heads off' removes the first two letters, P and R.
explanation.definitionFit: An ogress is a female ogre, a monster of fairy tales.

clue.text: Part in drag has theatregoers horrified

indicators.note: only a section of the following words is wanted, buried inside them

explanation.surface: An actor's role in drag shocks the audience.
explanation.definitionFit: Aghast means filled with sudden horror or shock.

clue.text: Boring agent everybody's spoken of

indicators.note: the word for everybody is said aloud rather than written

parts.note: everybody is all

explanation.surface: A dull person is someone everybody talks about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boring' suggests dull, but it means making holes.
explanation.definitionFit: An awl is a pointed tool for piercing holes, an agent of boring.

clue.text: Confusion about one building, originally concrete

indicators.note: the word for confusion goes round the other letters

parts.note: a tangle is a muddled state
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word building is taken

explanation.surface: Muddle surrounds a building whose material is concrete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts I and B (from 'originally' building) inside TANGLE.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective, concrete means real and able to be touched, a synonym.

clue.text: Cosmetic yours truly, say, must take on ship

indicators.note: signals that the pronoun is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a setter's way of saying I or me
a liner is a large passenger ship

explanation.surface: A make-up item travels with the writer aboard a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yours truly' means the setter, I, which is heard as EYE.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyeliner is a make-up product drawn along the rim of the eye.

clue.text: Seed said to be effective in opening spell

definitions.meaning: small oily seeds used on bread and in tahini
the magic word Ali Baba used to open the robbers' cave

explanation.surface: A seed is credited with power in a door-opening charm.
explanation.definitionFit: It names a plant seed and is the password in the Arabian Nights tale that opens the cave.
